objective: Make known external-validity and archive-bias risks observable and actionable without claiming that control protocols are real-world outcomes.

criteria.criterion: Independent hiring-reader comprehension is measured only through real dated sessions on an exact candidate.
Individual role and collective credit have collaborator corroboration or an explicit hold; silence is not approval.
Enumerable archive traces do not crowd out offline, relational, maintenance, or implementation work.
Whole-graph review detects mosaic privacy risk beyond record-level public-safety checks.
Author, optimizer, deterministic checker, model grader, and human reviewer remain distinct authorities.
Application and referral outcomes remain private, aggregate, and unattributed to the site without evidence.
Rubric, evidence, policy, and public-projection drift remain visible through hashes and lifecycle reports.
Five dated real job descriptions reveal role-specific proof strengths and gaps without rewriting employer needs.
